column1: # Bryo: every control, by context and gesture. One row per (context, control, gesture). Tab separated; lines
# starting with # are comments; the first other line is the header. tests/controls_check.py validates it.
# context   where the row applies: any | power-on | page (any device or slot page) | page:tape | page:grain |
#           page:ripple | page:color | page:chronos | page:drum (a DRUM track's own pages) | page:arp (the arpeggiator's page) | page:slot | mixer (GLO's
#           view) | glo-held | slot-held | scl-held (SCL down: the reset) |
#           slot-held+step (a SEQ slot's pad and a white key held) | project-view | routing-view | usb-record (the
#           USB record mode: REC held a second)
# control   BTN_<label> (the 14 buttons) | ENC_<role> (the 7 encoders) | POT_MASTER | WHITE_<n> (1..16, or a
#           range n-m) | BLACK_<label> (OP1..OP6 PIT GLO MONO POLY ZERO, left to right)
# gesture   press | tap (down and up within HOLD) | hold | release | turn | hold-turn (turn while the context's
#           pad is held) | combo (held together with what the context names)
# status    now (in the firmware, tested in tests/bryo_host.c) | planned (the PRD, in the phase named) |
#           proposed (mine, waiting for a decision) | unassigned
# phase     the build phase (docs/bryo-architecture.md) where it lands; - for now
# source    PRD section, or "change" (agreed in conversation), or "kept" (from Felucca)

column4: action
master output level (digital gain after the mix; USB follows unless USB LEVEL FIXED)
held with OCT+ for 5 s: UPDATE MODE countdown from 2 s, letting go cancels
held with OCT+ at power-on: HARDWARE CALIBRATION (press each button, turn each encoder)

focus the track's source (TAPE, SYNTH, POLY or DRUM) as HOME is let go (held for SELECT or a DRUM key: no page turn); again: its next HOME page (2026-10-15: the envelopes, filters and the kit's shape are ENV's only). TAPE: STRT LEN SPD PTCH, PTCH the speed in semitones; DUB GAIN XFAD REV; RPT FLEN WOW FLUT (RPT ON loops the FLEN ms, 10-1000, the head was in, the keys slicing it, until OFF; WOW a slow wandering of the speed, FLUT a quick flutter); REEL ROTA SYNC LVL, SYNC OFF or 1-16 bars, the loop that long at the tempo, its speed and pitch following, locked to the beat; HALF on OP6 alone. SYNTH's four: the oscillators (WAVE INTV DTUN MIX), VOICE (VOIC GLID TUNE FINE), MORE (PW NOIS SUB DRV; SUB a square an octave under, the classic waves'), LEVEL (CHRD TRAN . LVL; FM PD VOX WT show TRAN on MORE instead); POLY's four: REEL STRT END TUNE, LOOP (LOOP LSTR LXF TRAN: a held note loops FWD or PING; TRAN a click at every note's start, 3 ms of noise in front of the filter, on SYNTH, POLY and DRUM alike), TWIN, LEVEL (VOIC ROOT FINE LVL: ROOT the key that plays the sound as recorded, FINE cents); DRUM's three: PATTERN, VARY, STEP (INST BAR MODE LVL); round. Every source's last HOME page has LVL on KNOB 4 (-24..+6 dB: what the track hears of it, the S-4's LEVEL)

(as it's let go) focus GRAIN (SIZE RATE ROUT WET: every effect opens with its mix, ROUT WET at KNOB 3-4); again: GRAIN 2 (PTCH SPRD SPRY CONT), GRAIN 3 (REV PATN SCAL PRND), GRAIN 4 (SCAN WARP OFST FDBK), GRAIN 5 (BODY MODE ROOT TONE: a floor under the grains, the source low-passed or a TRI/SIN partial under each grain at its note in the octave over ROOT, starting and fading with the grain, through TONE; ROOT RES, below C1: over RIPPLE's root, so it rings the strings), GRAIN 6 (GRNS: AUTO shares the pool, a number 1-40 holds that many for the track whatever the others do; SYNC: RATE in the tempo's divisions, 1 bar to 1/64, a grain on each step of that grid in PATN's rhythm); again: RIPPLE (DEC TONE ROUT WET: what rings and its mix; COMB's DEC is FDBK, the resonators' RING and TILT), RIPPLE 2 (the form's own: strings SPRD RIPL DRV PICK; COMB POL SPRD RIPL DRV, POL ODD or ALL, the feedback inverted or not; RESO and 12-BAND FOCS WDTH FLOW SPRD, a spotlight on the bands, FLOW walking it up and down the spectrum by itself), RIPPLE 3 (PTCH SCAL KEYS PLVL: the root, the chord, KEYS PLCK, a key or a RIPL ARP step plucks, or TUNE, it only retunes what the track rings, a pluck's level; the resonators: PTCH SCAL DRV RIPL), RIPPLE 4 (CUT RES TYPE: the filter in front, and STRM, PICK or MODE), RIPPLE 5 (MODE VARY and the rest; COMB: MODE STRM VARY FLOW, FLOW bouncing the comb's pitch through the spectrum (E1 to E7 and back) by itself, free of PTCH, the keys and the chord while it flows; RESO and 12-BAND: 5 KEYS PLVL PICK STRM, 6 VARY EVEN, the odd partials against the even). Since 2026-10-18 a tap goes round the device shown (GRAIN's six, or RIPPLE's), from elsewhere back to the one last used; EDIT held + OCT- / OCT+: GRAIN / RIPPLE. ROUT on GRAIN, RIPPLE and COLOR: INS (WET crossfades the dry with the device) or SEND (the dry at full, the device added at WET)

(as it's let go) focus COLOR (DRV CRSH ROUT WET) or, from elsewhere, the one of COLOR and CHRONOS last used (2026-10-18: a tap goes round the device shown; FX held + OCT- / OCT+: COLOR / CHRONOS); again: COLOR 2 (NOIS TILT NDEC NTON), COLOR 3 (CMOD - - LVL); CHRONOS (TIME FDBK DLY VERB: the delay's level and the send to its room at KNOB 3-4; VERB's send follows the track's level and mute), CHRONOS 2 (SYNC TONE SPRD DUCK, how the echoes sit: SYNC, TIME in the tempo's divisions, 1/64 to 1/2, one longer than the 370 ms line halved until it fits, the strip shows what plays; the delay's tone and spread; DUCK, the echoes down while the track plays), CHRONOS 3 (AGE DIFF, what the repeats become: AGE, tape: each repeat saturated and darker, the time wavering; DIFF, each repeat smeared toward a wash), CHRONOS 4 (ROOM TYPE SIZE DEC: ROOM picks the shared room A or B it sends to, the rest are that room's, shared by every track on it; TYPE ROOM PLAT HALL SPRG), CHRONOS 5 (PRE RTON MOD QUAL, the room's: its pre-delay, tone, MOD its tail wavering slowly, QUAL HI 22.05 kHz or LO 11.025 kHz for half the work and a darker tail; the room's knobs aren't modulation targets)

the LFO pad's modulator: M1, M2 or M3 (the three swappable slots, each an LFO, ADSR or FOLLOW; LFO held + OP1 OP2 OP3 picks which, M1 to start), its page as the pad is let go; again: its next page. Every engine's last page ends AMT OFS on KNOB 3-4. Held, it sets depths instead (slot-held)

the source's shaping pages, only here (2026-10-15), again: the next: SYNTH's and POLY's AMP (ATK DEC SUS REL), FILTER (SYNTH: CUT RES TYPE KTRK; POLY: CUT RES TYPE), ENV 2 (ATK2 DEC2 SUS2 REL2) and SHAPE (ETYP: both envelopes ADSR, AD a strike whatever the key, LOOP round again while held; SYNTH: the wave's envelope depth, DEST CUT DRV PTCH where ENV 2 goes; ENV how far), TAPE's slice envelope (ATK DEC SUS REL), DRUM's KIT (every decay, with TUNE TONE DRV) and KIT 2 (TRAN). ENV is lit on them; held + a white key: that one. (M2 is on the LFO pad: LFO held + OP2)
M4's page, the step sequencer (always a SEQ: its engine doesn't swap), as the pad is let go; again: its page 2 (DIR TRIG PROB STRT), page 3 (- SPRD AMT OFS)

the arpeggiator's page (arp.c, not a modulator): MODE ORDR RNGE RATE; again: GATE SWNG GRND FADE (each step's gate at random, GRND points either side; FADE, how long the notes go on after every key is let go, fading out); again: RIPL ARP (RIPPLE's own arpeggio: MODE ORDR RNGE RATE). It plays the keys held one at a time, in time: SYNTH and POLY notes, TAPE's slices, DRUM's drums (RNGE stays 1 on those: no octaves)
open the mixer and keep it up
the mixer while held; letting go returns to the page
down: the reset (scl-held); on its own, nothing
held: a knob turned goes to its default, the page's own pad resets the page (scl-held). SAVE held puts back what the hold reset. (The system menu proposed here before needs another place)

REC held + PLAY: bounce the track (ui_input.c bounce_start): a take of the set bars (2 on FREE) of the track's own sound onto its tape from the next downbeat, the transport started if stopped, and the track on TAPE (its own tape) when the take is in; a TAPE track records itself through its effects (REC IN SELF for the take); a take on the tape is cleared first (SAVE held undoes); REC tapped before the downbeat calls it off

start / stop the transport: every track's tape plays its loop from the start (STOP fades them out in 2 ms); an arpeggiator's notes held with no key down (latched, piled up, a project's) start and stop with it

arm / disarm the focused track's tape: while playing it records the other tracks' mix (old x DUB + new x GAIN); armed on a reel, the reel is copied onto the tape first (refused if the tape holds a take). Playing: as REC goes down (a punch-in lands where it's pressed); stopped: as it's let go
held a second while stopped: the USB record mode (the tracks stop, the output plays the computer); playing: a hint to stop first

turned with REC held: the bars a take records, FREE 1 2 4 8 (the header: the number before the REC dot). Armed with bars, a take starts on PLAY's downbeat (armed while playing: the next bar's), is exactly that long (a blank tape loops at it, to the sample, and keeps it saved into a reel), then REC lets go by itself; the number counts down the bars left. The REC press it comes with doesn't arm or open the USB record mode
READY: start the take; RECORDING: stop it; CHOOSE: put it on the picked track (its tape replaced) and leave
back a step: RECORDING or CHOOSE: the take thrown away; READY: leave
CHOOSE: the track the take goes to (1..TRACKS)
CHOOSE: START, where the kept part begins (a block, 11.6 ms, a detent; faster turned fast)
CHOOSE: LENGTH of the kept part (the rest goes back to memory when it's kept)
CHOOSE: GAIN, -24..+24 dB; past +24: NORM (the loudest point to full scale)
CHOOSE: FADE at both cut points, 0..500 ms (10 ms to start with)

save into the project loaded or saved last (P1 to start with); the header's asterisk (changes not saved) goes; a track's own tape with a take goes into a user reel named after the project and track (P2T3), and SAVE says which tapes found no reel free

undo the last clear: the tape (POLY held, while nothing has been recorded over it), the track's modulation (MONO held) or a DRUM pattern (POLY held on a DRUM track, or PATN turned over an edited pattern), whichever came last
the white keys an octave down (SYNTH's and POLY's notes, RIPPLE's root; on DRUM's own pages: the bar, page:drum)
the white keys an octave up
the first value on the strip (and it becomes the page's last-turned: the visualization names it)
the second value on the strip
the third value on the strip
the fourth value on the strip
the global tempo, 40..240 BPM
open the project view (PROJECTS), pointing at the project loaded last
open REC IN (the routing view): what each track's REC records

TAPE: slice n of the focused track's loop (16 slices); playing: the head jumps there (crossfaded); stopped: that slice plays once. SYNTH and POLY: notes, key n the semitone n above C of OCT (until RIPPLE and SEQ give the keys their own jobs)
mute / unmute track 1 (with SETUP's KEYS on NOTE no black key is a shortcut: they play the sharps on SYNTH and POLY, F3-G5 with the white keys)
mute / unmute track 2
mute / unmute track 3
mute / unmute track 4
the focused track's tape: reverse on / off (TAPE 2's REV) (a TAPE track; on another source a message says so and the tape is left alone)
the focused track's tape: half speed on / off (TAPE 2's HALF) (a TAPE track; on another source a message says so and the tape is left alone)
global pitch shift down (unmuted tracks)
global pitch shift up (unmuted tracks)
held 0.5 s: clear the focused track's modulation (every depth of its four slots; the slots' own knobs stay; a slot's pad held too: only that slot's on the page shown, see slot-held); SAVE held undoes
held 0.5 s: clear the focused track's tape (a reel: the track goes back to its own tape, cleared); SAVE held undoes
momentary global granular freeze while held: every GRAIN buffer stops recording and its grains loop the held bars (SCAN TAPE: the cursor stops); FROZEN on the GRAIN page
the freeze latched until the next tap (its LED lit), as a tapped GLO latches the mixer: the right hand is free for GRAIN's knobs

REC held + 0: freeze to tape (ui_input.c freeze_to_tape): the bars GRAIN holds of the focused track (what went into GRAIN, the last 1, 2 or 4 bars) become its tape at once, the buffer's chunks changing hands, the track on TAPE, SYNC to those bars; GRAIN starts a fresh buffer. GRAIN off (WET 0, SCAN TAPE): said, nothing changes
play from slice n of the loop (finger drumming, stutter)
on a TAPE track: GRAIN's cursor to sixteenth n of the tape's loop (SCAN TAPE) or of the buffer (POS: the spot, DLY: the trail); the tape's head stays; stopped, grains while the key is held
(the key, not the POLY source engine) letting go before 0.5 s cancels the clear
the next page (PATTERN, VARY, STEP; KIT and KIT 2 are ENV's), round, as HOME is let go (as on every source), so HOME can be held for what follows
held + a white key: that page (the page keys, as on every pad); held + SELECT: the source, as on every track. STEP's instrument is its INST knob

PATTERN, VARY, KIT: the kit, key n left to right BD SD CP RS LC LB HB CL CB MA TB GU HH OH MB CY. STEP by MODE: HITS toggles step n of the bar shown for INST; ACC its accent; LIVE plays, and while playing writes it at the nearest step (not struck again when the step comes); ERAS wipes it as the playhead passes while held (silent). On STEP in HITS and ACC their LEDs show the bar: the set steps (or accents) lit, the rest glowing, the playhead flipping the key it is on

PATTERN, VARY, KIT: KNOB 1..4 are that instrument's own TUNE DEC LVL TONE while held (the header's box names it). Held first, then a modulator's pad (LFO, SEQ) + a knob: the depth to that instrument's knob (each hit takes the modulator's value as it's struck)

PATTERN: PATN writes its rhythm over the pattern (an edited one kept for SAVE), LEN 1-4 bars, SWNG, ACNT. VARY: SEED (0: as written; each other value a version that varies the pattern the way a player would), VARY, FILL, EVOL. KIT: TUNE DEC TONE DRV over every instrument. STEP: INST BAR MODE LVL
(DRUM's own pages; the track's device pages: the octave, as on every track) the bar STEP shows, down
(DRUM's own pages) the bar STEP shows, up, within LEN. STEP keeps showing that bar while playing (the keys write there; the playhead shows when it's in it); the other DRUM pages follow the playhead
held 0.5 s: clear the DRUM pattern (its tape stays); SAVE held undoes

the root, a semitone a key from C of OCT (until PTCH is turned). KEYS PLCK: on a TAPE or DRUM track the key plucks it alone (no slice, no drum), a sound of its own; KEYS TUNE: the key only retunes it, so what rings is the track's sound in that key. On SYNTH or POLY the keys still play the source and RIPPLE follows its notes.

held + SELECT, from any page: RIPPLE's form, RIPPLE (four strings), COMB (half-length lines fed back inverted, the odd harmonics), RESO (four resonant bands, DEC as RING, TONE as TILT), 12-BAND (twelve bands over the chord, a filter bank, a meter each), round; shown on RIPPLE's page (the page kept when it's up). Each form has its own name, labels and picture; the knobs are shared; switching clears what rang
on a SEQ slot's page: pick steps 1-16 (held keys are framed on screen and lit); the keys don't play the track here. Their LEDs: the steps in LEN (from STRT) glow, the step playing is lit
on a SEQ slot's page with white keys held: the held steps' values (0-100 %), instead of LEN
track 1 level (the fader's notches; its fill is the live meter)
track 2 level
track 3 level
track 4 level
close the mixer
close the mixer and focus the source (any page pad does the same for its page)
its first page, SCENES, while held (a key or a knob used: letting go returns to the levels; let go untouched, it stays as a tap)

steps the pages, each latched (as a tapped GLO latches the mixer): LEVELS, SCENES (four sounds to recall or morph between: below), CHANNEL (the selected track's LOW HIGH FILT PAN), MASTER (the compressor: AMT ATK REL MIX), KEY (the project's KEY and SCAL: with SCAL on, a SYNTH or POLY note outside the scale plays the nearest one in it), SETUP (KEYS KNOB HOLD LEDS: the panel's preferences, kept for the instrument), LEVELS

SCENES (the mixer's first EDIT page; the levels are only the levels, their keys play): scene 1-4, tapped, recalled as it's let go, the sound gliding there in 300 ms; an empty one says so. A scene is every track's source and the knobs of its sound, the levels, the rooms, the tempo (switched at the midpoint; a scene saved before scenes had one leaves it alone) the arpeggiators' knobs (MODE ORDR RNGE RATE switched at the midpoint, GATE SWNG GRND FADE morphing) and each modulator's AMT (morphing), not the tapes, patterns, steps, the modulators' other knobs, depths, mutes, the notes the arpeggiators hold, or the key. The same source: its knobs morph, a choice switching at the midpoint; another source: the track fades out, switches, fades in. The keys don't play on SCENES

SCENES: KNOB n morphs toward scene n, 5 % a detent, from the sound as it was at its first detent, nothing held (2026-10-13: holding two keys to morph was hard); another knob morphs on from there. Under each knob the scene's tracks' sources (lit: another source than now, a fade) and a bar of how far it's got

SCENES: tapped with a scene's key (white 1-4) held: the sound as it is into that scene (no project save). Scenes are saved with the project, as what differs from it; one that doesn't fit is saved empty and SAVE says so
focus track 1..4 (the white keys don't play while GLO is held)
the four track levels; letting go of GLO returns to the page

TRACKS 1-4: the tracks in use; the ones above it park (silent, not rendered, their tapes taken first when memory runs short). A pad held + SELECT picks that pad's thing, as HOME + SELECT (the source) and a slot + SELECT (its engine); plain SELECT stays the tempo on every view
back to the page if something was done or it was held past HOLD; else the mixer stays up

(and every black key) KEYS NOTE (the black keys are notes): held GLO makes them the shortcuts again: OP1-4 mute (their LEDs lit while GLO is held), OP5 OP6 the tape's REV HALF, MONO and POLY held clear, 0 freezes (as a note it doesn't)
SETUP's KEYS flipped: the black keys as the shortcuts, or as notes (the 27 keys a keyboard from F on SYNTH and POLY)

the depth (-100..100 %) from this slot to that knob on the page shown: a device, the source (each source its own depths), the channel strip. The strip shows the slot's depths while it's held; a modulated knob gets a mark. Not the reel choices; at most 12 depths from one slot and 32 a track (the footer counts the held slot's: DEPTH 7/12); a 13th says so, and the slot's pad + MONO clears its depths on the page. Turned back to 0 it catches there (gone): a turn that keeps going stays at 0 until the knob rests 250 ms, then goes on into the other sign. Let go: the page stays
held 0.5 s with the pad: clear that slot's depths on the page shown (other slots', other pages' stay); the pad let go first calls it off. SAVE held undoes
that slot's engine (LFO ADSR SEQ FOLLOW on the LFO pad's M1-M3; the SEQ pad's M4 stays a SEQ, and says so), starting from that engine's defaults; its depths stay; the tempo is left alone
the LFO pad held: it shows M3 from now (a knob turned next sets M3's depth; let go without one: M3's page). Other pads: the key's own job
the LFO pad held: it shows M2 from now (a knob turned next sets M2's depth; let go without one: M2's page). Other pads: the key's own job
the LFO pad held: it shows M1 from now (a knob turned next sets M1's depth; let go without one: M1's page). Other pads: the key's own job

a page's pad held (HOME EDIT FX ENV LFO SEQ ARP): white key n jumps to its page n (EDIT: GRAIN's pages then RIPPLE's; FX: COLOR's then CHRONOS's). While the pad is held the keys show its pages: dim for each, lit for the one shown, the rest dark (LFO also lights OP1-OP3, its modulator bright). The keys don't play meanwhile; let go without a key and the pad turns its page as usual
held + SELECT, from any page: the track's source engine, TAPE, SYNTH, POLY, DRUM, shown on its first page; each keeps its own knobs, the switch crossfades
with EDIT or FX held: that pad's first device, its first page (GRAIN, COLOR); the pad's let-go turns no page, the octave stays (2026-10-18)
with EDIT or FX held: that pad's second device, its first page (RIPPLE, CHRONOS) (2026-10-18)

turned with HOME held, on TAPE's first page (STRT, LEN) or POLY's (STRT, END): the zoom. A click moves the edge a hundredth of a percent (the knob is in hundredths: without HOME a click is a whole percent), the value shows to the hundredth, the picture the decoded sound around the edge with its time; HOME's let-go doesn't turn the page then

the SEQ pad held, then a step's white key: the SEQ's depth to that knob on that step only (a p-lock, mod.c mod_plk_nudge), any value, 0 too; back at the SEQ's own depth it's gone. Up to 32 a track over 8 knobs; MONO clears them with the depths; saved with the project. The value under each knob shows the step's depth (bright: locked). A step key let go without a turn: SEQ's page n, as before
that knob to its default (any view with knobs: a page, the mixer's levels, channel and master, REC IN); PATN is turned, not reset (it writes a pattern)
on a source page: every knob on the page shown to its default, no page turn (the page's own pad, the lit one, does this on every page)
on GRAIN or RIPPLE (or the mixer's channel and master pages): the page shown to its defaults
on COLOR or CHRONOS: the page shown to its defaults
on the mixer's levels: every track's level to 100
on an LFO-pad slot's page (and ENV, SEQ, ARP on theirs): the page shown to its defaults; the slot's depths stay (MONO clears those)

point at the next or previous of the six project slots (on the PRESETS page: of the eight track presets, A..H, then the eight factory ones, 1..8: DRIFT RINGS (TAPE), BASS PAD (SYNTH), KEYS SWELL (POLY), TIGHT DUB (DRUM)); past P6: FACTORY, the start-up scene. On the REELS page: U1..U6

the view's pages, round: PROJECTS, PRESETS (a track's sound: source and its knobs, the devices, the channel strip, the slots and depths; not the pattern, level, REC IN or the room CHRONOS sends to), REELS (your user reels U1..U6: name, length, the tracks playing each), as EDIT steps the mixer's

load the slot pointed at (it stops the transport); with changes not saved, asked first: OCT+ again within 3 s. On the PRESETS page: the preset (or factory one) into the focused track, no question (SAVE held puts the track back), playing on. On an EMPTY slot: a new project there, blank (every knob at its default, every track an empty tape of its own, no pattern, no depths, 120 BPM; saved by SAVE). On FACTORY: the start-up scene (the evolving one Bryo plays with nothing saved), your projects left as they are
leave the project view (any page pad does too)

save into the slot pointed at; over another project, asked first: SAVE again within 3 s. On the PRESETS page: the focused track saved as the preset pointed at (over another, asked the same way); a factory one can't be saved over (FACTORY: SAVE INTO A..H). On FACTORY: it says to save into P1..P6

held 0.5 s: delete the project pointed at (the user reels it saved stay); on the PRESETS page, the preset (a factory one stays); on the REELS page, the reel pointed at (from any slot a long one covers; a track playing it goes silent); FACTORY stays
nothing (the view has no knobs)
the focused track's REC IN (AUTO OTHR T1-T4; its own number: SELF)
track 1..4's REC IN: AUTO (as before: the others on TAPE, its own source on SYNTH or POLY), OTHR (the others' mix), T1-T4 (one track; its own: SELF)
leave REC IN for the source (any page pad does the same for its page; GLO for the mixer)

MODE (OFF KEY LTCH ADD HOLD: the latched chord whole and sustained, no steps), ORDR (UP DOWN UPDN RND PLAY), RNGE (1-3 octaves), RATE (1/4 1/8 8T 1/16 16T 1/32); page 2: GATE (10-400 %: past 100 the notes ring into the next steps, overlapping; TAPE and DRUM stop at 100), SWNG, GRND, FADE (let every key go and the notes go on this long, fading; 0: KEY stops at once, LTCH and ADD hold); page 3, RIPL ARP: RIPPLE's MODE ORDR RNGE RATE (stored in RIPPLE's knobs 12-15)
held 0.5 s: forget the notes the arpeggiator holds (a latched chord, an ADD pile); on RIPL ARP, RIPPLE's arpeggio's

the notes (SYNTH, POLY), slices (TAPE) or drums (DRUM) it arpeggiates (KEY: while held; LTCH: the last chord goes on; ADD: each joins for good). A note playing on without its key (latched, piled up, fading): its key pressed again takes it out; a key during a FADE brings the level back. With the arpeggiator on, the keys of the notes it holds are lit and the one sounding goes dark for its step. On RIPL ARP with its MODE on: the notes RIPPLE's arpeggio plucks the strings at (KEYS TUNE: retunes them to), a semitone a key from C of OCT, the track quiet (any source); a latched or piled-up pattern plucks on off the page. MODE OFF: as the other ARP pages
